title: Products per category
statementMd:
For each category, show the number of products and the average price rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `category`, `products`, `avg_price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
